name: Related Transaction Data 1
definition: Provides information on individual transactions that the payment instruction has been split into.

MasterUETR.name: Master UETR
MasterUETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide an end-to-end reference of a master payment transaction and to which one or multiple sub payment transactions can be linked.

SubUETR.name: Sub UETR
SubUETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide an end-to-end reference of a sub payment transaction which may be linked to a master payment transaction.
